This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

This relay is used as a backup short circuit protection at reduced voltage, the 
current required for operation will be corresponding reduced. At zero voltage 
operation is obtained with a current of less than 20% of rated relay current.

certified by eng. Gaber

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
